Proves AR-6's `inRange` operator on a `date` field with an inclusive `from` / exclusive `to` boundary combination. Per SEM-4, the exact default inclusivity AG Grid's own date filter uses for `inRange` is explicitly flagged in the TRD as 'verify at implementation time and freeze', not asserted as settled fact here — this fixture pins one illustrative combination of the mechanism (explicit flags read literally by the compiler), not a claim about AG Grid's default. Since AG Grid's native `inRange` wire shape carries no inclusivity flags at all, this fixture uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point to inject a `rangeComparisonNode` with explicit `fromInclusive`/`toInclusive` flags directly (see the category README).
